[[File:Bodyguard_droid_HK-55.jpg|thumb|250px|[[HK-55]], [[Lana Beniko]]'s bodyguard droid]]
'''Bodyguard droids''' or '''defense droids''' were a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] designed to protect their organic masters. [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Isis (Governor)|Isis]] kept two bodyguard droids hidden behind false monitor screens in her office.

The [[Ranger X-1]] model doubled as a defense droid and a [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]].<ref name="The Destroyer">[[Droids (1986) 1|''Droids'' (1986) 1]]</ref>
